records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net sales increased approximately 61% for the thirteen weeks ended May 1, 2021 as compared to the thirteen weeks ended May 2, 2020 driven by increased store foot traffic relative to last year which was impacted by widespread temporary store closures due to COVID-19, and year-over-year digital sales growth of approximately 45%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In light of store closures related to COVID-19, the Company has not disclosed comparable sales for Fiscal 2020 or Fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: There have been no material changes during the thirteen weeks ended May 1, 2021 in the contractual obligations as of January 30, 2021, with the exception of those obligations which occurred in the normal course of business (primarily changes in the Company’s merchandise inventory-related purchases and lease obligations, which fluctuate throughout the year as a result of the seasonal nature of the Company’s operations).

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first quarter of Fiscal 2021, stores and distribution expense decreased 2% as compared to the first quarter of Fiscal 2020, primarily driven by a $32 million reduction in store occupancy expense reflecting a decrease in store count and favorable rent negotiations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company relies on excess operating cash flows, which are largely generated in Fall, to fund operations throughout the year and to reinvest in the business to support future growth.
